findings.title: Moving strongest comparator is not actionably frozen
findings.description: The plan requires comparison against the moving strongest same-protocol non-MLLM comparator, but does not define the candidate set, source ledgers, selection criterion, tie-breaks, or no-final-test rule needed to make strongest reproducible.
findings.risk: The final C2 performance claim can be under- or over-stated by an ambiguous comparator choice.
findings.concrete_fix: Add a comparator-freeze artifact before M2 with eligible systems, hashes, selection metrics, tie-breaks, and proof that selection uses no final test labels or adaptive held/query labels.

findings.title: Direct-moment control required by proposal is missing or not explicit
findings.description: The final proposal lists DIRECT-MOMENT, DIRECT-CERT-FEATURE, and SCALAR-PROPENSITY controls. The experiment plan/machine JSON list one DIRECT certificate distillation arm and scalar propensity, leaving direct moment replaceability untested unless the direct arm is expanded.
findings.risk: A direct structural-moment route could match FULL, invalidating mechanism attribution without being tested.
findings.concrete_fix: Add an explicit DIRECT-MOMENT arm or define DIRECT certificate distillation to cover both moment and certificate-feature routes; update arms, schemas, Table 2, gates, and budgets.

findings.title: Control matching provenance can leak or become test-adaptive
findings.description: SHUFFLE matching uses label/prediction/margin/error-propensity bins while M4 scope is final train/test. The plan does not state that all bins, propensities, and matching manifests are train-only or pre-final OOF/validation artifacts.
findings.risk: Control construction could accidentally use final test labels, predictions, margins, or errors, creating leakage or adaptive test use.
findings.concrete_fix: Require matching bins and scalar/error-propensity estimates to come only from train/OOF or preregistered validation artifacts frozen before final test evaluation; add counters proving final test data are evaluator-only.

findings.title: M4 control bundles are under-budgeted for multiple trained arms
findings.description: Each M4 bundle contains five arms and says direct/scalar controls use the same split/init/schedule/inference constraints as FULL. The bundle budget is 36 GPU-h, while a single M3 comparator or FULL run is budgeted at 18 GPU-h; four trained controls would imply about 72 GPU-h per bundle before overhead.
findings.risk: The plan hides multi-arm compute and may exceed the stated 480 GPU-h budget.
findings.concrete_fix: Split M4 controls into per-arm runs or itemize shared-work assumptions; recompute GPU/CPU/storage totals and concurrency after adding DIRECT-MOMENT.

findings.title: Hierarchical paired bootstrap and Holm protocol are underspecified
findings.description: The plan names hierarchical paired bootstrap and Holm correction but does not define the resampling hierarchy, uncertainty unit, paired statistic, macro-F1 recomputation, one-sided lower-bound rule, or p-value source.
findings.risk: The final C2 statistical gate is not implementable and could be inconsistently interpreted.
findings.concrete_fix: Define the dataset x metric paired test exactly, including seed/video hierarchy, bootstrap statistic, CI/lower-bound calculation, p-values, Holm ordering, and joint enforcement of +0.030 and lower>0.

findings.title: Aggregate CPU/storage budget arithmetic does not match run matrix
findings.description: Summing machine runs gives 488 must-run CPU-h and 504 total CPU-h, not declared 504/520. Must-run storage sums to 578 GB and total storage to 583 GB, not declared 575/580. GPU/API totals match.
findings.risk: Resource planning and hash-bound run matrix are inconsistent.
findings.concrete_fix: Regenerate aggregate totals from the run list after control-budget revisions.

findings.title: Final inference isolation counters are not schema-complete
findings.description: The text forbids validation/test cache, compiler target, teacher, head, reranker, key selector, and certificate-feature loads, but machine zero counters cover only cache/teacher/MLLM call categories.
findings.risk: A forbidden validation/test artifact load might not be represented as a required zero counter in machine artifacts.
findings.concrete_fix: Add explicit counters for validation/test cache reads, certificate reads, compiler-target reads, head loads, reranker loads, key-selector loads, and teacher artifacts.

findings.title: Terminal decision-chain summary omits M3 paired-main completion
findings.description: The actual DAG is acyclic and dependencies recover the correct order, but the terminal decision chain jumps from M2 decision to M4 controls decision without an explicit M3 paired-main-complete node.
findings.risk: Machine consumers using the summary chain rather than dependencies may present an incomplete execution state.
findings.concrete_fix: Add an explicit M3 paired-main-complete decision node to the terminal chain.

findings.title: Validation/test source hashes need provenance clarification
findings.description: Machine source hashes include validation/test JSONL files without saying these hashes are provenance-only and not cache, matching, selection, or G0 access.
findings.risk: Readers may confuse provenance hashing with experimental data access before allowed gates.
findings.concrete_fix: Mark val/test hashes as provenance-only or move them to final evaluator provenance artifacts generated after freeze.
